text=Path('sequences.fasta').read_text().splitlines()
seqs={}
cur=None
for l in text:
  if l.startswith('>'):
    cur=l[1:].strip(); seqs[cur]=''
  else:
    seqs[cur]+=l.strip().lower()
inp=seqs['input']; outp=seqs['output']
print('in len',len(inp),'out len',len(outp))
n=min(len(inp),len(outp))
pre=0
while pre<n and inp[pre]==outp[pre]:
    pre+=1
print('prefix',pre)
print('inp around:', inp[pre-60:pre+20])
print('out around:', outp[pre-60:pre+60])
suf=0

    suf+=1
print('suffix overlap',suf)
print('inp unique:', inp[pre:len(inp)-suf])
print('out unique:', outp[pre:len(outp)-suf])
ins=outp[pre:len(outp)-suf]
print('insert len', len(ins))
print('insert:', ins)
print('upstream60:', outp[pre-60:pre])
print('downstream60:', outp[pre+len(ins):pre+len(ins)+60])

{"content":"from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
text=Path('sequences.fasta').read_text().splitlines()
seqs={}
cur=None
for l in text:
  if l.startswith('>'):
    cur=l[1:].strip(); seqs[cur]=''
  else:
    seqs[cur]+=l.strip().lower()
inp=seqs['input']; outp=seqs['output']
# insertion point in input coords = 213, in output: upstream end 213, downstream start 252
ins = outp[213:252]
print("ins",ins,len(ins))
upstream_top = inp[:213]  # ends with ...catatg
downstream_top = inp[213:]  # starts agcaag...
print("up tail 60:",upstream_top[-60:])
print("down head 60:",downstream_top[:60])

def oligotm(seq):
    # seq uppercase
    r=subprocess.run(["oligotm","-tp","1","-sc","1","-mv","50","-dv","2","-n","0.8","-d","500",seq.upper()],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if r.returncode!=0:
        return None, r.stderr
    return float(r.stdout.strip()), None

def rc(s):
    comp=str.maketrans("acgtACGT","tgcaTGCA")
    return s.translate(comp)[::-1]

# test Tm equality forward vs revcomp
for s in ["agcaagggcgag","catatg","aaggagatatacatatg"]:
    t1,_=oligotm(s)
    t2,_=oligotm(rc(s))
    print(s,t1,"rc",rc(s),t2)

print("--- forward candidates (downstream prefix) ---")
fwd=[]
for L in range(15,46):
    anneal=downstream_top[:L]
    tm,_=oligotm(anneal)
    flag="OK" if 58<=tm<=72 else ""
    print(f"L={L} tm={tm:.2f} {flag} {anneal}")
    fwd.append((L,tm,anneal))
print("--- reverse candidates (upstream suffix revcomp) ---")
rev=[]
for L in range(15,46):
    top_suffix=upstream_top[-L:]
    primer=rc(top_suffix)
    tm,_=oligotm(primer)
    # also tm of top_suffix itself
    tm2,_=oligotm(top_suffix)
    flag="OK" if 58<=tm<=72 else ""
    print(f"L={L} tm_primer={tm:.2f} tm_top={tm2:.2f} {flag} top:{top_suffix} primer:{primer}")
    rev.append((L,tm,primer,top_suffix))
